Where the key actually is
This is a Privy embedded wallet on base-fork. Its key is split so that no single party — not Privy, and certainly not xorr — can reconstruct it alone; using it needs you to be signed in. xorr never sees it, which is why the bot gets a permission instead of a key.

Your funds stay in a wallet you control. xorr never holds them and cannot move them to an address you have not allowlisted.
